summary:
Fixed the snapshot commit-gap bug.

Changed:
- [app/snapshot.go](/app/app/snapshot.go): `InstallSnapshot` now compacts log entries covered by the snapshot and advances `commitIndex` to at least `LastIncludedIndex`.
- [app/raft.go](/app/app/raft.go): restart recovery no longer moves `lastApplied` behind the restored snapshot boundary when the saved commit index is lower.

Verification:
- Ran `gofmt`
- Ran `./test.sh`
- Result: all 3 rounds passed, no duplicate state machine transitions.
